$comment: Combat presentation tuning: where the fighters stand, how the camera frames them, how the orb flies. Consumed by CombatStage/stagePlacement/Player camera framing.

placement.$comment: allyForward: metres ahead of the player the ally takes the field. gap: minimum ally-to-enemy distance; a closer enemy is pushed back to it.

camera.$comment: The combat framing Player lerps toward while a fight runs: pulled back, raised, over the shoulder, looking across the ally at the enemy.

telegraph.$comment: The enemy tell: a crouch-and-swell on the root while cb__telegraph flashes.
